---
title: "📝 T1 Collected Notes"
subtitle: "A COLLECTION OF THOUGHTS, OBSERVATIONS, AND LEARNINGS"
page-layout: full
listing:
  contents: posts
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  date-format: "MMMM DD, YYYY"
  fields: [date, title, subtitle, description, categories, image]
---

```{=html}
<style>
  /* [보정 1] 포스트 타이틀: Apple 표준 Charcoal(#1d1d1f) 및 호버 시 Apple Blue(#007aff) */
  .quarto-post .title a,
  .listing-title a {
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .quarto-post .title a:hover,
  .listing-title a:hover {
    color: #007aff !important; /* 인터랙티브 요소 강조 */
    text-decoration: none !important;
  }

  /* 날짜 표시 영역 정렬 및 줄바꿈 자간 최적화 */
  .listing-date {
    line-height: 1.4 !important;
    text-align: left !important;
    font-family: "SF Pro Text", sans-serif;
    color: #1d1d1f;
  }

  /* [보정 3] 연도별 구분선 헤더 슬림화 (2px -> 1px) */
  .custom-year-heading {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin: 3.5rem 0 1.5rem 0 !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #1d1d1f; /* 두께를 1px로 두어 샤프한 느낌 강조 */
    padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
    font-family: "SF Pro Display", sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  /* 카테고리 태그 미니멀 디자인 */
  .listing-categories .listing-category {
    border: 1px solid #e8e8ed !important;
    background-color: transparent !important;
    color: #86868b !important;
    border-radius: 4px !important;
    font-size: 0.7rem !important;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  /* 우측 연도 필터 레이아웃 및 톤앤매너 동기화 */
  .custom-year-filter-wrapper {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed;
    padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .filter-section-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  .year-filter-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .year-link {
    color: #86868b;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .year-link:hover, .year-link.active {
    color: #007aff; /* 우측 필터 액티브 컬러도 Apple Blue로 일치 */
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
</style>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const posts = document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-post');
    if (!posts.length) return;

    const years = new Set();

    posts.forEach(post => {
      const dateEl = post.querySelector('.listing-date');
      if (dateEl) {
        const dateText = dateEl.innerText; // 예: "May 18, 2026"
        const match = dateText.match(/\d{4}/);
        if (match) {
          const year = match[0];
          years.add(year);
          post.setAttribute('data-post-year', year);
        }

        /* [보정 2] 월·일과 연도 사이 줄바꿈(br) 및 하단 연도 서식 고도화 */
        if (dateText.includes(',')) {
          const parts = dateText.split(',');
          const monthDay = parts[0].trim();  /* May 18 */
          const yearNum = parts[1].trim();   /* 2026 */
          
          // 연도 부분은 살짝 크기를 줄이고 투명도를 주어 계층 구조 형성
          dateEl.innerHTML = `${monthDay}<br><span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 400; display: inline-block; margin-top: 2px;">${yearNum}</span>`;
        }
      }
    });

    const sortedYears = Array.from(years).sort((a, b) => b - a);

    // 본문 영역 연도 헤더 삽입
    sortedYears.forEach(year => {
      const firstPostOfYear = document.querySelector(`.quarto-post[data-post-year="${year}"]`);
      if (firstPostOfYear) {
        const heading = document.createElement('h2');
        heading.className = 'custom-year-heading';
        heading.innerText = year;
        firstPostOfYear.parentNode.insertBefore(heading, firstPostOfYear);
      }
    });

    // 우측 사이드바 연도 필터 주입
    const quartoSidebar = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category');
    if (quartoSidebar) {
      const yearFilterContainer = document.createElement('div');
      yearFilterContainer.className = 'custom-year-filter-wrapper';
      
      let yearLinksHtml = `<div class="filter-section-title">Year</div><div class="year-filter-list">`;
      yearLinksHtml += `<a href="#" class="year-link active" data-target-year="all">All</a>`;
      sortedYears.forEach(year => {
        yearLinksHtml += `<a href="#" class="year-link" data-target-year="${year}">${year}</a>`;
      });
      yearLinksHtml += `</div>`;
      
      yearFilterContainer.innerHTML = yearLinksHtml;
      quartoSidebar.insertBefore(yearFilterContainer, quartoSidebar.firstChild);

      // 연도 필터 인터랙션 이벤트 바인딩
      const yearLinks = yearFilterContainer.querySelectorAll('.year-link');
      yearLinks.forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          yearLinks.forEach(l => l.classList.remove('active'));
          link.classList.add('active');

          const targetYear = link.getAttribute('data-target-year');
          const allHeadings = document.querySelectorAll('.custom-year-heading');

          if (targetYear === 'all') {
            posts.forEach(p => p.style.display = 'flex');
            allHeadings.forEach(h => h.style.display = 'block');
          } else {
            posts.forEach(p => {
              if (p.getAttribute('data-post-year') === targetYear) {
                p.style.display = 'flex';
              } else {
                p.style.display = 'none';
              }
            });

            allHeadings.forEach(h => {
              if (h.innerText === targetYear) {
                h.style.display = 'block';
              } else {
                h.style.display = 'none';
              }
            });
          }
        });
      });
    }
  });
</script>
```
